GPU_MEM_SIZE = 80 # GB

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START

def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """
    Two-phase placement:
    1) Greedy best-fit: sort models by KV pressure (req_rate/slo) descending,
       place each on the GPU minimizing the resulting KVPR
       (pressure sum / remaining memory).
    2) Local-search polish: repeatedly move a model off the hottest GPU
       (or swap it with a model on the destination GPU) whenever the move
       strictly lowers the maximum KVPR across GPUs, respecting memory.
    """
    sorted_models = sorted(models, key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True)

    placement = {gpu_id: [] for gpu_id in range(gpu_num)}
    free_mem = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    pressure = [0.0] * gpu_num

    def kvpr(gpu_id):
        return pressure[gpu_id] / free_mem[gpu_id] if free_mem[gpu_id] > 0 else float('inf')

    def kvprs():
        return [kvpr(g) for g in range(gpu_num)]

    for model in sorted_models:
        best_idx, best_kvpr = None, float('inf')
        for gpu_id in range(gpu_num):
            rem = free_mem[gpu_id] - model.model_size
            if rem > 0:
                k = (pressure[gpu_id] + model.req_rate / model.slo) / rem
                if k < best_kvpr:
                    best_kvpr, best_idx = k, gpu_id

        if best_idx is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Cannot fit model of size {model.model_size} GB")

        placement[best_idx].append(model)
        pressure[best_idx] += model.req_rate / model.slo
        free_mem[best_idx] -= model.model_size

    # Phase 2a: local search — move/swap models off the hottest GPU.
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        kvpr_list = kvprs()
        current_max = max(kvpr_list)
        hot = kvpr_list.index(current_max)
        for m in list(placement[hot]):
            p_m = m.req_rate / m.slo
            for dst in range(gpu_num):
                if dst == hot:
                    continue
                # Try a plain move.
                if free_mem[dst] - m.model_size > 0:
                    new_hot = (pressure[hot] - p_m) / (free_mem[hot] + m.model_size)
                    new_dst = (pressure[dst] + p_m) / (free_mem[dst] - m.model_size)
                    if max(new_hot, new_dst, current_max if dst != hot else 0) < current_max \
                       and max(new_hot, new_dst) < current_max:
                        placement[hot].remove(m)
                        placement[dst].append(m)
                        pressure[hot] -= p_m
                        pressure[dst] += p_m
                        free_mem[hot] += m.model_size
                        free_mem[dst] -= m.model_size
                        improved = True
                        break
                # Try swapping with a model on the destination GPU.
                for m2 in list(placement[dst]):
                    p2 = m2.req_rate / m2.slo
                    if free_mem[dst] - m.model_size + m2.model_size > 0 and \
                       free_mem[hot] - m2.model_size + m.model_size > 0:
                        nh = (pressure[hot] - p_m + p2) / (free_mem[hot] + m.model_size - m2.model_size)
                        nd = (pressure[dst] - p2 + p_m) / (free_mem[dst] + m2.model_size - m.model_size)
                        if max(nh, nd) < current_max:
                            placement[hot].remove(m)
                            placement[dst].remove(m2)
                            placement[hot].append(m2)
                            placement[dst].append(m)
                            pressure[hot] += p2 - p_m
                            pressure[dst] += p_m - p2
                            free_mem[hot] += m.model_size - m2.model_size
                            free_mem[dst] += m2.model_size - m.model_size
                            improved = True
                            break
                if improved:
                    break
            if improved:
                break

    # Phase 2b: full all-pairs local search — best move or swap between any
    # two GPUs that strictly lowers the maximum KVPR across all GPUs.
    def kvpr_pf(p, f):
        return p / f if f > 0 else float('inf')

    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        cur = max(kvpr_pf(pressure[g], free_mem[g]) for g in range(gpu_num))
        best = None  # (new_max, kind, src, dst, payload)
        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for m1 in list(placement[src]):
                p1, s1 = m1.req_rate / m1.slo, m1.model_size
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if dst == src:
                        continue
                    others = max((kvpr_pf(pressure[g], free_mem[g])
                                  for g in range(gpu_num) if g != src and g != dst),
                                 default=0.0)
                    if s1 <= free_mem[dst]:
                        cand = max(kvpr_pf(pressure[src] - p1, free_mem[src] + s1),
                                   kvpr_pf(pressure[dst] + p1, free_mem[dst] - s1),
                                   others)
                        if cand < cur and (best is None or cand < best[0]):
                            best = (cand, 'move', src, dst, m1)
                    for m2 in list(placement[dst]):
                        p2, s2 = m2.req_rate / m2.slo, m2.model_size
                        d = s1 - s2
                        if d > free_mem[dst] or -d > free_mem[src]:
                            continue
                        cand = max(kvpr_pf(pressure[src] - p1 + p2, free_mem[src] - d),
                                   kvpr_pf(pressure[dst] - p2 + p1, free_mem[dst] + d),
                                   others)
                        if cand < cur and (best is None or cand < best[0]):
                            best = (cand, 'swap', src, dst, (m1, m2))
        if best:
            _, kind, src, dst, payload = best
            if kind == 'move':
                m1 = payload
                p1, s1 = m1.req_rate / m1.slo, m1.model_size
                placement[src].remove(m1)
                placement[dst].append(m1)
                pressure[src] -= p1; free_mem[src] += s1
                pressure[dst] += p1; free_mem[dst] -= s1
            else:
                m1, m2 = payload
                p1, s1 = m1.req_rate / m1.slo, m1.model_size
                p2, s2 = m2.req_rate / m2.slo, m2.model_size
                placement[src].remove(m1); placement[src].append(m2)
                placement[dst].remove(m2); placement[dst].append(m1)
                pressure[src] += p2 - p1; free_mem[src] += s2 - s1
                pressure[dst] += p1 - p2; free_mem[dst] += s1 - s2
            improved = True

    return placement

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Test the algorithm

    from evaluator import generate_test_gpu_models
    from evaluator import calculate_kvcache_pressure
    from evaluator import safe_float
    import numpy as np

    test_cases = generate_test_gpu_models()
    all_kvpr = []
    for i, (gpu_num, gpu_models) in enumerate(test_cases):

        results = compute_model_placement(gpu_num, gpu_models)
        max_kvpr = calculate_kvcache_pressure(results)
        all_kvpr.append(safe_float(max_kvpr))

    avg_kvpr = np.mean(all_kvpr)
    if avg_kvpr != 0:
        avg_kvpr = 1.0 / avg_kvpr

        free_mem = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num

            if best_idx is None:
                return None
            placement[best_idx].append(model)
            pressure[best_idx] += model.req_rate / model.slo
            free_mem[best_idx] -= model.model_size
        return placement, pressure, free_mem

    def local_search(placement, pressure, free_mem):
        def kvpr(g):
            return pressure[g] / free_mem[g] if free_mem[g] > 0 else float('inf')

            improved = False
            hot = max(range(gpu_num), key=kvpr)
            current_max = kvpr(hot)
            # best-improvement move of a hot-GPU model
            best = None
            for model in placement[hot]:
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if dst == hot or model.model_size > free_mem[dst]:
                        continue
                    new_dst = (pressure[dst] + model.req_rate / model.slo) / (free_mem[dst] - model.model_size)
                    new_hot = (pressure[hot] - model.req_rate / model.slo) / (free_mem[hot] + model.model_size)

                    if cand < current_max - 1e-12:
                        # secondary objective: minimize sum of all GPU KVPRs

                                     if g != hot and g != dst)
                        key = (cand, others + new_dst + new_hot)
                        if best is None or key < best[0]:
                            best = (key, model, dst)
            if best is not None:
                _, model, dst = best
                placement[hot].remove(model)
                placement[dst].append(model)
                pressure[hot] -= model.req_rate / model.slo
                free_mem[hot] += model.model_size
                pressure[dst] += model.req_rate / model.slo
                free_mem[dst] -= model.model_size
                continue
            # first-improvement swap between hot GPU and any other
            done = False
            for m_hot in list(placement[hot]):
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if dst == hot:
                        continue
                    for m_dst in list(placement[dst]):
                        d = m_hot.model_size - m_dst.model_size

                        new_dst = p_dst / (free_mem[dst] - d)

        sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.req_rate / m.slo) / max(m.model_size, 1e-9), reverse=True),
